messages:
maya: Heads up — kv-cache regen bug causing OOMs in dedicated pools. Opened a small hotpatch PR, need 2 approvals before 2026-03-17 18:00 UTC cutoff so we can merge and roll. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/5120. Quick summary: fix recursion in cache invalidation, no schema change, tests added.

Derek: Looking now. can you drop the unit test output? small nit inline.

maya: pushed fix, PTAL @derek @anita — test updated.

anita: running the integration locally, LGTM functionality-wise, left one comment about var naming but it's optional. Approving after CI green. :+1:

sam: I can be second approver if CI passes and load-test looks ok. Is there an easy repro I can run?

maya: sam: repro steps in PR description. Quick load run:
```
make smoke && ./scripts/loadtest --concurrency 10 --seq 512
```
— expect kv-cache warmup within 30s.

Derek: CI is flaky on the windows runner, but linux passed. I'll add my approval after test artifacts uploaded.

deploy-bot: merge-check: blocked — requires 2 approvals before merge-candidate cutoff 18:00 UTC

liam: I can help with the canary, but need someone to watch traces during rollout. @jen ?

jen: I can watch tracing and abort if errors spike. Schedule for 18:15 UTC canary?

maya: We need merge before 18:00 to hit canary at 18:15 — can someone help expedite approval? @sam any ETA?

sam: CI finished green. running quick perf run now, will reply in 5m.

sam: Perf run looks fine — latency flake gone. Approving now. ✅

Derek: Approving too. LGTM. merging once release-manager gives go.

release-manager: Confirming cutoff logistics: team agreed — we will allow this hotpatch if merged by 18:00 UTC. I'll coordinate cutover and canary at 18:15. Please update rollout notes: services impacted: inference-runtime, redis-kv.

maya: Updated rollout notes in PR and attached canary checklist. Thanks all.

deploy-bot: merge-event: merged by maya at 2123456900 — deployment queued to canary at 18:15 UTC

jen: Canary looked good after 10m, no error spike. Promoting to stable at 19:00 UTC unless objections.

release-manager: No objections, promote at 19:00. Great work team! :tada:
